obligations.instruction: Use a face-large head-and-shoulders or chest-up frame with a neutral facial key separated from environmental accent light. Keep thin satin correction, brow hairs, neutral lashline-to-crease diffusion, a micro outer liner taper, separated lashes, muted bilateral cheek color, and the centered soft-edge satin lip simultaneously readable. Bare skin, opaque glam, digital smoothing, colored light, or one dominant feature cannot substitute for the balanced applied system.

render_gates.description: Sheer-to-light satin correction remains applied while fine skin texture and natural tonal variation stay visible.
Soft low-arch brow structure and individual brow hairs remain readable.
Neutral taupe-brown pigment is deepest near the upper lash roots and diffuses softly through the crease.
Slim interlash definition ends in a very short tapered outer extension rather than a broad wing.
Upper lashes remain cleanly separated with restrained volume.
Muted rose pigment remains softly bilateral on the cheeks and separate from environmental color cast.
Rosy-coral lip color peaks near the inner center, fades to a softened edge, and retains low satin-balm sheen.
The complexion leads while eye cheek and lip treatments remain mutually restrained; bare face opaque glam smoothing and colored light do not substitute.
